summary.text: Kenya Wicks, a Democrat, was elected to the Georgia State Senate in November 2024 and represents the 34th Senate District; she was sworn in on January 13, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Her official biography describes her as a Louisville, Kentucky native and retired U.S. Army major whose 30-year military career took her from enlisted soldier to officer.
It says she earned a Bachelor of Science in Environmental Science from the University of Alabama and serves as a Court-Appointed Special Advocate for children in foster care in Clayton County.
